metaDescription: Order custom Gary cooling sport towels in bulk. Perfect for teams, events, and corporate giveaways. Get a quote at Perfect Imprints.
introHtml: Gary cooling sport towels are built for heavy use, with microfiber fabric that stays cool when wet and resists odors. Whether you need custom towels for a golf tournament, a summer safety kit, or a corporate fitness challenge, these towels hold up to repeated wetting and wringing. Decorate with your logo using screen printing or heat transfer for a crisp, long-lasting imprint that won't wash off.
